admission.justification: A quality procedure that asks for a file the product no longer writes cannot be run at all; the requirement and the adoption skill must name the current owner together.

applicability: The transferred memory-quality-control and baseline-adoption procedure after the retirement.
conditions: The kept owner is c-05-create-or-update-onboarding-files/workflows/memory-quality-control.md, and the durable result is the contract-scoped checklist memory_quality_check replaces at the reportPath it returns, with no temporary drift report filed.
A retired task-start drift file is not required to run it.
exclusions: Keeping a dead file reference as a compatibility note.
statement: The transferred MQC and baseline-adoption procedure names the current report/result owner rather than requiring a retired task-start drift file.
